The '''New Brampis system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Atlas Companion" /> It contained thw [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[New Brampis]], the site of the [[New Brampis Starship Museum]]<ref name="Allies" />
